## Result: clean - `merge-ready`

Reviewed head: `a34a2e5d8273ccf3d3f5582194bee2cab53b88a5`.
Trial merge: the head merges cleanly with upstream/main `6898b02ea3195e9124e6113afd6ab3cee38d0c50`. All builds and tests ran on that merge, locally on macOS. No runner was used.
Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4474#issuecomment-7230575452

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR changes posted G-code (`assets/posts/mazak.cps`).

## What the PR does

- `nextSeq()` records each N number that it writes in `usedBlockNumbers`. It skips a number that is already used. It refuses an increment that rounds to 0 or less, and a number that does not advance.
- `alarmUnless()` reserves the probe label before it writes the `IF[..]GOTO` block. It skips a label that is already used.
- The jump target goes through `rawBlock`. The target line now has one N word and no automatic prefix.

This agrees with the "Done means" of #4342.

## Build and tests (on the trial merge)

Quick gate `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 43 steps, 0 failed.

- `post build` and the 10 post suites: `lib`, `post_engine`, `script_arcs`, `script_cycles`, `script_dialects`, `script_edm`, `script_goldens`, `script_probe` (44 passed), `script_rotary`, `script_wcs`. All ok.
- `app build` and the 30 app suites of the plan. These include `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `conformance`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `tilt_basis_compat`, `catalog_groove_part_off` and `probe_no_coolant`. All ok.
- `site tests`: 132 tests, ok.

Other steps:

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed (release build, motion lib, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, app `pocket_pass_start`).
- Heavy lanes: not run. The PR is `P3`, so AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" asks for no heavy step.

Extra suites run:

- Test data: the diff changes no file under `testdata/`. The new golden is in `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/mazak/`. The post suites read that directory through `recorded/mod.rs`, and all of them ran (above).
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. No kernel suite was necessary.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

Each mutation was made on the trial merge, and the `mazak_sequence_labels` module was run. Then the file was restored, and `script_probe` passed again with 44 tests.

1. `rawBlock(["N" + probeLabel])` changed back to `block(...)`: RED. 4 of 5 tests fail (golden, jump targets, collisions, sections).
2. The skip loop in `nextSeq()` removed (`while (false)`): RED. `probe_labels_never_collide_with_numbered_blocks` and `probe_labels_remain_unique_across_sections_and_word_spacing` fail.
3. The skip loop on `probeLabel` removed (`probeLabel += 1` only): RED. The same two tests fail.

## Goldens

Goldens moved: one new file, `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/mazak/probe_every_block.nc`. No existing golden changes. The body lists this correctly.

Line-by-line check:

- The golden is the existing `probe.nc`, with an `N` prefix on each block. When the prefix `N<digits> ` is removed from each line, the file is identical to `probe.nc`. Thus no motion, feed, alarm condition or work-offset word changed.
- The automatic numbers are `N10` to `N790`, in steps of 10, each one time.
- There are 13 `GOTO9001` to `GOTO9013`. Each one has one standalone target line `N9001` to `N9013`, after its `#3000` alarm block.
- No N number occurs two times.

## Law check (upstream main AGENTS.md)

- Prime Directive: the new refusals throw an error by name. The test `nonadvancing_sequence_options_are_refused_by_name` shows that `engine::run_with` returns `Err` and does not crash. The skip loops end, because each loop step adds a positive value and the used set is finite.
- Default output with numbering off does not change. The existing Mazak goldens and `conformance` pass.
- Tests: the new module joins the existing `script_probe` directory suite. It has a provenance line and a gate map. `expect` is used only in tests.
- `docs/decisions/4342-mazak-probe-sequence.md` is present. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #4342`.
- No process file, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change. No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary.
- Clean room: the change is original logic. No vendor text is copied.

## Optional, non-blocking

- In "Every block" mode, a target such as `N9001` is between `N100` and `N110`. A Fanuc-family control accepts N numbers out of order. The body says that no physical Mazak control ran the program. This is a correct statement of the limit.
- The decision file says that #4413 or this PR must add `G94` to the new golden, whichever merges second. The merging session must remember this.
